description: This source file contains utility functions for processing nested tensors in CUDA, specifically for sequence length calculations, validation, and reshaping for attention mechanisms in a deep learning context.

methods.name: get_nnz
methods.description: Calculates the total number of non-zero elements (sequence length sum) in a nested tensor.

methods.name: cumulative_and_max_seq_len_nnz
methods.description: Computes cumulative sequence lengths, maximum sequence length, and total sum for a nested tensor, used in attention kernels.

methods.name: is_safe_to_get_storage_as_tensor
methods.description: Checks if a nested tensor's storage layout is safe for direct tensor access without copying.

methods.name: view_as_dense
methods.description: Reshapes a nested tensor into a dense tensor view suitable for attention computations.

methods.name: sdpa_nested_preprocessing
methods.description: Preprocesses nested query, key, and value tensors for attention, handling broadcasting and reshaping.

methods.name: sdpa_nested_preprocessing_backward
methods.description: Prepares gradients and tensors for backward pass in nested tensor attention operations.
